messages:
jules: Heads up  build red on release after today's typegen run. sample-app crashes at boot.

matt: saw it. quick stack: enum parse error in AuthRetryStrategy.

ci-bot: pipeline 6129 failed: job 'integration/sample-app'.

ci-bot: ```
Error: UnrecognizedRetryStrategy: received 'LINEAR' but expected one of [\"linear\", \"exponential\"]
    at parseRetryStrategy (/workspace/sdk/lib/auth/strategy.js:27:15)
    at startServer (/workspace/sample-app/server/start.js:14:5)
```

regen-bot: regen diff: packages/typegen/out/auth.d.ts changed: RetryStrategy enum values normalized to UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (LINEAR, EXPONENTIAL). Marked as non-breaking by auto-labeler.

jules: ugh. runtime parser is case-sensitive and expects lowerCamel/strings. This is a public shape change.

anna: how did the normalizer choose UPPER_SNAKE? config flag \"enumStyle: SHOUT\" got enabled in the pipeline by mistake.

matt: immediate options: 1) revert typegen commit, 2) add tolerant parsing in SDK to accept any case, 3) publish new SDK and bump semver. Revert fastest.

jules: revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/410 (undo enumStyle). Adding test to lock enum casing.

regen-bot: suggested local repro: `yarn workspace @redwood/typegen regen && node ./scripts/parse-test.js`

anna: while revert runs, let's add a small tolerant parser in SDK to accept both lower/upper. I can open a patch PR.

matt: please include tests and changelog note. This patch should be a patch release to unbreak consumers.

anna: patch branch created with shim:

```js
// packages/sdk/src/auth/strategy.js
function parseRetryStrategy(s) {
  const normalized = String(s).toLowerCase();
  if (normalized === 'linear') return 'linear';
  if (normalized === 'exponential') return 'exponential';
  throw new Error(`UnrecognizedRetryStrategy: received ${s}`);
}
```

matt: looks good. open PR and request urgent publish. Also, add a small sample-app smoke step in the regen job: after regen, npm pack the SDK and run sample-app start.

jules: opened ticket DEVEX-345: \"enum normalization in typegen must preserve public enum casing; add regen smoke test and semver gating\". Assigned to devex.

ci-bot: PR 411 (revert) CI passing. Merged.

anna: PR 412 (compat shim + tests + changelog) opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412. CI green. Requesting publish.

release-bot: publishing @redwood/sdk@1.9.1 (patch) now. Post-release verification will run sample-app smoke test against published tarball.

matt: follow-up items: - lock enumStyle config to \"preserve_public\" by default - add a typegen-impact check that diffs runtime parsing tests - require semver label for any typegen change that affects exported enums/fields.

jules: agreed. I'll add a checklist to the PR template and extend the regen bot to detect enum casing diffs and fail CI unless overridden.

ci-bot: post-release sample-app verification job started.

matt: once publish verified, we'll close the revert and add the long-term changes. Thanks for fast reaction. :thumbsup:

jules: closing loop: DEVEX-345 created, PRs merged, publish in flight. Will follow up on regen bot changes in separate ticket.
